scientific_scope: All 101 samples, reference-qualified masks and absolute complex tails, both independently executed amplitudes and both CFL values satisfy the unchanged 1% and pi/N observation budgets at N1600. No error or uncertainty subtracted to obtain acceptance.

Two CFL values demonstrate measured sensitivity, not a temporal convergence order or certified zero-step error. Epsilon comparison is observed normalized difference, not automatic linearity of full nonlinear kernel.

Supports a proposed N1600 resolution obligation for this specified free-reflection case. Does not retroactively pass historical N200/400/800, complete their spatial/stability obligations, approve rigid cases or full VAL010/S06.
cost_scope: GNU time describes each run over the prescribed single acoustic transit, with four concurrent processes initially. Kernel initialization, assessment and process timing differ; report each label explicitly.

These data demonstrate executable cost on this environment, not acceptable full two-stroke engine-cycle cost. No engine geometry, cycle horizon, multiple ducts, smallest-cell dt, material coupling or hardware target has been benchmarked.

A claim of practical GEN1 engine runtime requires an explicit representative model/horizon and a stated cost budget followed by measurement. This missing application cost decision does not invalidate the narrow numerical resolution evidence or authorize loosening its 1% gate.
Adjudication may accept the bounded resolution obligation with cost limitations explicitly retained; it may not claim full-engine performance qualification or infer it from a single transit.
